name: HYDRA-UMC-EDITOR-URDF
build: Desktop PySide6/Qt6 + Qt Quick app. run.bat/run.sh runs it from source; build-test.bat/build-test.sh validates sources without versioning; build_exe.bat/build_exe.sh produces a standalone PyInstaller executable.
notes: Desktop graphical URDF creator/editor with real, shipped features (GitHub/local source loading, mesh reference resolution, DOF feasibility validation, live 3D preview editing) - pushes finished models to HYDRA-UMC-STUDIO's own model catalog via HYDRA-UMC-SERVER's POST /api/models/submit.
